thread.title: Dow Jones Up On Jobs Report; Amazon Stock Falls | Investor's Business Daily

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Dow Jones Up On Jobs Report; Amazon Stock Falls | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The major stock indexes posted uneven gains early Friday after January payroll numbers smashed estimates. The Labor Department reported a 304,000 surge in job growth in January. The Dow Jones industrials gained about 150 points in today's stock market . Meanwhile, the Nasdaq climbed out of early losses and into narrow gains, held back by FANG stock Amazon.com's ( AMZN ) disappointing earnings results. Amazon stock is a major component of the Nasdaq and S&P 500 index.
X The Nasdaq reversed its early loss and gained 0.1%. The S&P 500 index advanced 0.3%, while the Dow Jones industrials led with a 0.6% rise. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today page.)
Dow Jones Stocks: Apple Stock Extends Win Streak Among the Dow Jones stocks, Apple ( AAPL ) moved up for a third straight day, following the iPhone maker's better-than-expected earnings results on Jan. 28. Apple stock moved up about 1%.
Exxon Mobil ( XOM ) and Chevron ( CVX ) both advanced about 2.5% after their respective earnings results early Friday. Exxon is making a bid to regain its 50-day line, while Chevron is nearing its long-term 200-day line.
Meanwhile, Merck ( MRK ) is nearing a potential breakout above a flat base's 80.29 buy point with a 3% gain. The drugmaker reported its earnings results before the stock market open.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Stock Market: Amazon Stock Falls, Deckers Breaks Out Amazon stock faltered after the company's Q4 earnings release after the stock market close Thursday. The company's Q4 results topped estimates, but its Q1 guidance missed the Street's targets. Amazon stock fell over 4% to give up a large portion of the past two days of heavy gains. Shares were still above their 50-day moving average, as the e-commerce giant shapes the right side of a new base formation.
Deckers Outdoor ( DECK ) jumped 9% after the Ugg-boots maker easily beat fiscal-Q3 estimates . Shares are breaking out above a double bottom's 132.33 buy point.
Edwards Lifesciences Slips Edwards Lifesciences ( EW ) narrowed heavy losses to 0.7% after the company's earnings results late Thursday. The stock is about 3% away from a 175.10 buy point.
According to the IBD Stock Checkup , Edwards Lifesciences stock has a 97 out of a highest-possible 99 IBD Composite Rating . The Composite Rating measures the strength of a stock's fundamental and technical metrics.
IBD 50 Stocks To Watch: Trade Desk Among the IBD 50 stocks , Trade Desk ( TTD ) gained almost 2% in morning trade. The top stock is approaching a double bottom's 149.10 buy point.
On the downside, Kirkland Lake Gold ( KL ) fell 1.7%. The gold miner triggered the 20%-25% profit-taking sell signal from a 23.96 buy point this week.
